config.section.title: Storage sizes
config.section.note: Set how many slots each kind of storage holds. 36 is the normal game size, so leaving a row at 36 keeps that storage untouched. New storage types (including modded chests) show up here once you load a save that has them.
config.default.name: Default size (everything else)
config.default.tooltip: Used for any storage that doesn't have its own row below, including modded chests you haven't used yet. Change a row below to give that one type its own size.
